## Set-up

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# Load data

## Load data for outcome variable (on-time performance, or OTP)
OTP <- read_csv("MTA_Subway_Terminal_On-Time_Performance__Beginning_2015_20260415.csv")

## Load data for predictors

### Technical predictors
ridership <- read_csv("MTA_Daily_Ridership_and_Traffic__Beginning_2020_20260415.csv")
funding <- read_csv("MTA_Statement_of_Operations__Beginning_2019_20260415.csv")
roll <- read_csv("nyc_mta_rolling_stock.csv")
lengths <- read_csv("nyc_mta_line_lengths.csv")

### Demographic predictors
income <- read_csv("nyc_boros_income.csv")
race <- read_csv("nyc_boros_race.csv")
stations <- read_csv("nyc_mta_station_count.csv")
```

## Final dataset

### Data prep

```{r}
# Drop unnecessary rows from each dataset 

## Drop rows from OTP dataset
OTP <- OTP %>% filter(between(month, as.Date("2021-01-01"), as.Date("2024-12-31"))) %>% 
  filter(line != "S Fkln") %>% # drop shuttle service 
  filter(line != "S Rock") %>% # drop shuttle service
  filter(line != "S 42nd") %>% # drop shuttle service
  filter(line != "GS") %>% # drop shuttle service
  filter(line != "FS") %>% # drop shuttle service
  filter(line != "H") # drop shuttle service

## Drop rows from ridership dataset
ridership <- ridership %>% filter(between(mdy(Date), as.Date("2021-01-01"), as.Date("2024-12-31"))) %>% 
  filter(Mode == "Subway")

## Drop rows from funding dataset
funding <- funding %>% filter(between(Month, as.Date("2021-01-01"), as.Date("2024-12-31"))) %>%
  filter(Scenario == "Adopted Budget", Agency == "NYCT") %>%
  filter(str_detect(Type, "expense") | str_detect(Type, "Expense"))
```

```{r}
# Drop unnecessary columns from each dataset

## Drop columns from OTP dataset
OTP <- OTP %>% select(month, line, day_type, num_on_time_trips, num_sched_trips)

## Drop columns from ridership dataset
ridership <- ridership %>% select(Date, Count) # We know it's all subway data anyways

## Drop columns from funding dataset
funding <- funding %>% select(Month, Amount) # We will be summing across every month in a year

## Drop columns from rolling stock dataset
roll <- roll %>% select(line, count_roll_stock, avg_roll_age, range_roll_age)

## Drop notes column from length dataset
lengths <- lengths %>% select(!limited_service)
```

```{r}
# Add / alter values and variables

## Change "J" label to "JZ" in OTP data
### The JZ observations have a gap between Dec. 2019 and Sept. 2024. The missing
### observations for these times actually are filed under the J line instead for
### technical reasons -- since the J and Z have the same route, we treat them as
### one line to get a continuous string of values from 2021 - 2024
OTP$line[OTP$line == "J"] <- "JZ" 
## Reformat day_type to take the values 0 and 1; 0 means weekday, 1 means weekend
OTP$day_type[OTP$day_type == "1"] <- 0
OTP$day_type[OTP$day_type == "2"] <- 1
## Add late trips column
OTP <- OTP %>% mutate(num_off_time_trips = num_sched_trips - num_on_time_trips)
### We will need to use these values to assemble our rows later

## Sum ridership values to get yearly totals
ridership <- ridership %>% group_by(year = year(mdy(Date))) %>% summarize(Count = sum(Count))
## Adjust units (from ones to ten-thousands)
ridership$Count <- ridership$Count / 10000

## Sum expenses to get NYCT's yearly adopted budget
funding <- funding %>% group_by(year = year(Month)) %>% summarize(Amount = sum(Amount))
## Adjust units (from ones to millions)
funding$Amount <- funding$Amount / 1000000

## Find average lengths (maximum extents, from start to end) for each line
lengths <- lengths %>% group_by(line = line) %>% summarize(length_miles = mean(length_miles))

## Get proportions of stations in each borough for each line
stations <- stations %>% mutate(prop_stations_bx = count_station_bx / total_stations,
                                prop_stations_b = count_station_b / total_stations,
                                prop_stations_m = count_station_m / total_stations,
                                prop_stations_q = count_station_q / total_stations)
## Drop count columns
stations <- stations %>% select(line, prop_stations_bx, prop_stations_b, prop_stations_m, prop_stations_q)
```

```{r}
# Compute new metrics

## Our borough level statistics do not capture a lot of neighborhood-level
## variation for our lines, which usually pass through multiple boroughs -- to 
## get around this, we compute a certain weighted average to get at the typical
## demographic that a line serves. The formula we use for a given line,
## for the variables income and pct. non-white is:
  ## \text{station weighted avg statistic}_{line} = \sum_i (\text{proportion of stations for 
  ## $line$ in borough}_i \times \text{yearly statistic in borough}_i )
## so, we compute the average income or percent non-white for a line, weighted
## by the number of stations it serves in each borough

## Compute income station-weighted average (SWA)
SWA_income <- stations %>% cross_join(income) %>% ## Makes combinations for mutate
  mutate(swa_inc = prop_stations_bx * med_inc_bx + ## Compute weighted avg
           prop_stations_b * med_inc_b + 
           prop_stations_m * med_inc_m + 
           prop_stations_q * med_inc_q) %>% 
  mutate(swa_inc = swa_inc / 1000) %>% # Change units of income to thousands
  select(line, year, swa_inc)

## Compute race SWA
SWA_race <- stations %>% cross_join(race) %>% ## Makes combinations for mutate
  mutate(swa_race = prop_stations_bx * pct_nonwhite_bx + ## Compute weighted avg
           prop_stations_b * pct_nonwhite_b + 
           prop_stations_m * pct_nonwhite_m + 
           prop_stations_q * pct_nonwhite_q) %>% 
  select(line, year, swa_race)
```

### Joining tables

```{r}
# Convert monthly OTP observations into yearly summed observations for each line
OTP <- OTP %>% mutate(year = year(month)) %>% 
  group_by(year, line, day_type) %>% 
  summarise(yearly_on_time = sum(num_on_time_trips), 
            yearly_off_time = sum(num_off_time_trips))
```

```{r}
# Final join, on year and line
OTP <- OTP %>% 
  left_join(ridership) %>% ## Yearly total ridership, in tens of thousands
  left_join(funding) %>% ## Yearly NYCT adopted budget, in millions
  left_join(roll) %>% ## Rolling stock diversity and age
  left_join(lengths) %>% ## Average maximum extents of each line
  left_join(SWA_income) %>% ## SWA of income for each line and year
  left_join(SWA_race) ## SWA of race for each line and year

# Adjust rolling stock average ages to change with the year
OTP <- OTP %>% mutate(avg_roll_age = year - avg_roll_age)
```

```{r}
# Turn counts into individual rows for logistic regression
OTP <- OTP %>% rowwise() %>% ## Group input by rows
  mutate(off_time = list(c(rep(0, yearly_on_time), ## Replicate on-time obs. as 0
                           rep(1, yearly_off_time)))) %>% ## Replicate late obs. as 1
  unnest(off_time) ## unnest() turns each cell (which contains lists) into individual rows
```

```{r}
# Drop old count columns
OTP <- OTP %>% select(!yearly_on_time) %>% select(!yearly_off_time)

# Rename columns
OTP <- OTP %>% rename(ind_weekend = day_type,
                      yearly_total_ridership = Count,
                      yearly_adopt_budget = Amount,
                      avg_max_extent = length_miles,
                      SWA_inc = swa_inc,
                      SWA_race = swa_race,
                      ind_off_time = off_time)
```

```{r}
write_csv(OTP, "on_time_performance.csv")
```
